question: Under RBI/2026-27/279, who may approve internal guidelines for outward forex remittances based on online or physical Form A2 submission?
reference_answer: The Board, or a Board Committee or Management Committee to which the Board has delegated powers.

v1.text: The internal guidelines must be approved by the authorised dealer’s Board – or, where the Board has delegated authority, by any Board Committee or Management Committee that has been given that power【ad30a12a41afa632d97786d24974653ca1c7ee026da7f3e9b2dbbe88835bbbcc p.1】.

v2.text: Under RBI/2026‑27/279, authorised dealers must frame internal guidelines for outward forex remittances with the approval of **their Board, or any Board Committee/Management Committee to which the Board has delegated such powers**【ad30a12a41afa632d97786d24974653ca1c7ee026da7f3e9b2dbbe88835bbbcc p.1】.

A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 23 October 01, 2026
To
All Authorised Dealers in Foreign Exchange
Madam / Sir

Online submission of Form A2: Removal of limits on amount of remittance
Attention of Authorised Dealers (ADs) Category I banks and AD – Category II entities
is invited to paragraph 3 of A.P. (DIR Series) Circular No. 12 dated July 03, 2024, on
the captioned subject, in terms of which they were advised to frame appropriate
internal guidelines with the approval of their Board, for the purpose of facilitating
outward forex remittances on the basis of online / physical submission of Form A2 and
other related documents.

2. On a review, it has now been decided that Authorised Dealers shall frame
appropriate internal guidelines with the approval of their Board or any Board
Committee / Management Committee to which powers have been delegated by the
Board, for the purpose mentioned in the aforesaid circular.
[End Source 1]
